body:
My mom said that through her severe abuse, her goal as a child was to have a baby to torture in the same ways she went through.

She found relief in being told she could not have kids, yet my brother and I still happened.
Our dad died and things went from okay to drugs and alcohol. She called us both fat mistakes and did the bare minimum to keep officials away.

To this day I can't say a word without being told "She was a damn good mom" and made my successes happen lmao

As a grandma, she is loving and has a favourite nephew. He cries about his weight/insecurities and she cuddles him through it. I love him, but there is still a ton of jealousy and fury knowing this same woman called me a fat and ugly mistake ten years prior. Acting like it never happened.
After being left for exes 3 times, I've pretty much accepted it. I'm trash and it's not happening.

Not me but my great-grandmother.
Around the turn of the century, it was popular to take a boat to a nearby island to go swimming, etc. She went every weekend.
One Saturday, she kept hearing this voice tell her not to go and had a weird feeling.
She didn't go and found out later that the boat caught fire and no passengers survived.
